method_limitations.matrix: Finite nonempty rectangular numeric data<=100000rows,1024columns,1000000cells; fitting further capped256rows/16fixednumericfeatures. Exact signed subject IDs<=2^53-1.
method_limitations.time_semantics: Parameters refer to sorted global time levels. AR1 covariance=variance*rho^abs(actual_elapsed_time);negative rho requires integral gaps. Toeplitz requires uniform global grid and uses lag in grid increments;missing visits retain global lag. Antedependence multiplies all intervening global adjacent correlations,including omitted visits. Other heterogeneity parameters are categorical by ordered level.
method_limitations.SPD: Variances>0;correlations strictly(-1,1);CS rho>-1/(m-1);all matrices SPD at relative per-diagonal Cholesky pivot1e-12. No pseudoinverse. Full-rank whitened design relative QR threshold1e-11.
method_limitations.likelihood: Exact Gaussian conditional/profile likelihood;REML includes original-design determinant,so response and feature rescaling affects restricted likelihood by the mathematically required constants. AIC/BIC counts fixed coefficients plus covariance parameters;REML comparisons require identical fixed designs. Known-covariance method2 AIC/BIC=null.
method_limitations.uncertainty: coefficient_covariance/SE conditional on covariance estimate only;covariance parameter SE/CI/tests not supplied. Local profile Hessian is an identification diagnostic only. covariance_parameters_identified=false or boundary causes converged=false. optimizer_converged separately reports solver result.
method_limitations.covariance_boundary: Search coordinate abs>24.9 (repeated coordinate cap25),relative variance<=1e-12,relative conditional pivot<=1e-8,or random G determinant/diagonal<=1e-8 criteria. These numerical boundary diagnostics do not provide boundary-mixture tests.
method_limitations.fit_limits: Max30000likelihood evaluations and1000000000nominal blockdense work units;line search<=40trials;max1000iterations. Repeated covariance<=8levels,unstructured<=36covariance parameters. Numerical failure/invalid input/work exhaustion errors explicitly.
method_limitations.saved_model: [p,response_origin,response_mean_offset,response_population_scale,standardized_intercept,feature_origins(p),feature_mean_offsets(p),feature_population_scales(p),standardized_fixed_slopes(p),n_subjects,(subject_id,normalized_intercept_BLUP,normalized_slope_BLUP)*n_subjects]. Here p includes the auto fixed slope;last fixed feature is the random slope covariate.
method_limitations.outputs: coefficients ordered intercept,other fixed slopes,auto slope;standard_errors same order. fitted_values are marginal fixed-effect means. conditional_fitted_values add BLUPs. blups columns are original-unit random intercept and raw-slope coefficient. covariance_parameters uses physical layouts above.

import numpy as np
from scipy import optimize
from research import cov,profile,serial
SEED=892104
rng=np.random.default_rng(SEED)
proc=subprocess.Popen(['/private/tmp/rusta-ducksmiles-jmp-target/mixed-advanced-check/runner'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)

def run(op,data,args=[]):
 line=op+'|'+','.join(map(str,args))+'|'+ ';'.join(','.join(map(str,row)) for row in data)
 proc.stdin.write(line+'\n');proc.stdin.flush();out=proc.stdout.readline().strip()
 if out.startswith('ERROR'):raise AssertionError((op,out))
 r=json.loads(out);assert r['version']==1
 return r
def close(a,b,label,rtol=2e-5,atol=2e-7):
 global worst
 a=np.asarray(a);b=np.asarray(b)
 assert a.shape==b.shape,(label,a.shape,b.shape)
 err=np.max(np.abs(a-b)/np.maximum(1,np.abs(b))) if a.size else 0.
 if err>worst[0]:worst=(float(err),label)
 assert np.allclose(a,b,rtol=rtol,atol=atol),(label,err,a,b)
def count(name):
 global checks
 checks+=1;families[name]=families.get(name,0)+1
def parameters(code,m):
 v=np.exp(rng.uniform(-1.5,1.5,m))
 if code==0:return v
 if code==1:
  L=np.tril(rng.normal(0,.2,(m,m)));L[np.diag_indices(m)]=np.sqrt(v);C=L@L.T;return C[np.tril_indices(m)]
 if code==2:return [v[0],rng.uniform(-.1,.65)]
 if code==3:return np.r_[v,rng.uniform(-.1,.65)]
 if code==4:return [v[0],rng.uniform(.1,.8)]
 if code==5:return np.r_[v[0],.6**np.arange(1,m)]
 if code==6:return np.r_[v,.6**np.arange(1,m)]
 if code==7:return np.r_[v,rng.uniform(-.65,.65,m-1)]
 return np.r_[v[0],rng.uniform(-.65,.65,m-1)]
def block_cov(data,C):
 V=np.zeros((len(data),len(data)));ts=np.unique(data[:,-1])
 for gid in np.unique(data[:,-2]):
  ix=np.flatnonzero(data[:,-2]==gid);ti=np.searchsorted(ts,data[ix,-1]);V[np.ix_(ix,ix)]=C[np.ix_(ti,ti)]
 return V
def known_oracle(data,C):
 p=data.shape[1]-3;x=np.c_[np.ones(len(data)),data[:,:p]];y=data[:,p];V=block_cov(data,C)
 vi=np.linalg.inv(V);info=x.T@vi@x;b=np.linalg.solve(info,x.T@vi@y);e=y-x@b
 ll=-.5*(len(y)*np.log(2*np.pi)+np.linalg.slogdet(V)[1]+e@vi@e)
 return b,np.linalg.inv(info),x@b,ll
for k in range(360):
 code=k%9;m=int(rng.integers(2,7));t=np.arange(m,dtype=float)
 if code==4 and k%2:t=np.cumsum(rng.uniform(.3,1.8,m));t-=t[0]
 p=parameters(code,m);C=cov(code,t,p)
 r=run('repeated_covariance',t[:,None],[code,*p]);close(r['covariance'],C,'builder',1e-12,1e-12)
 count('covariance_builder')
for k in range(120):
 code=k%9;m=int(rng.integers(3,6));t=np.arange(m,dtype=float);p=parameters(code,m);C=cov(code,t,p)
 rows=[];nf=k%3
 for group in range(5):
  ix=np.arange(m) if group<2 else np.flatnonzero(rng.random(m)>.2)
  if len(ix)==0:ix=np.array([0])
  feats=rng.normal(size=(len(ix),nf));x=np.c_[np.ones(len(ix)),feats]
  y=x@np.arange(1,nf+2)/3+rng.multivariate_normal(np.zeros(len(ix)),C[np.ix_(ix,ix)])
  rows.extend(np.c_[feats,y,np.repeat(group,len(ix)),t[ix]])
 rows=np.array(rows);r=run('repeated_model',rows,[code,2,300,1e-8,*p]);b,bc,f,ll=known_oracle(rows,C)
 close(r['coefficients'],b,'known_beta',1e-10,1e-10);close(r['coefficient_covariance'],bc,'known_cov',1e-10,1e-10);close(r['fitted_values'],f,'known_fitted',1e-10,1e-10);close(r['log_likelihood'],ll,'known_ll',1e-10,1e-10)
 count('known_covariance_GLS')

def repeated_oracle(data,code,init,reml):
 # Full physical covariance parameters with every scale optimized explicitly.
 m=len(np.unique(data[:,-1]));t=np.unique(data[:,-1]);p=data.shape[1]-3;x=np.c_[np.ones(len(data)),data[:,:p]];y=data[:,p]
 ns=m if code in [0,3,6,7] else 1
 if code==1:
  L=np.linalg.cholesky(cov(code,t,init));L[np.diag_indices(m)]=np.log(L[np.diag_indices(m)]);th=L[np.tril_indices(m)]
 else:th=np.r_[np.log(init[:ns]),init[ns:]]
 def decode(th):
  if code==1:
   L=np.zeros((m,m));L[np.tril_indices(m)]=th;L[np.diag_indices(m)]=np.exp(L[np.diag_indices(m)]);return L@L.T
  return cov(code,t,np.r_[np.exp(th[:ns]),th[ns:]])
 def objective(th,full=False):
  try:
   C=decode(th);e=np.linalg.eigvalsh(C)
   if min(e)<1e-9:return 1e30
   V=block_cov(data,C);vi=np.linalg.inv(V);info=x.T@vi@x;b=np.linalg.solve(info,x.T@vi@y);res=y-x@b
   ll=-.5*((len(y)-x.shape[1] if reml else len(y))*np.log(2*np.pi)+np.linalg.slogdet(V)[1]+res@vi@res+(np.linalg.slogdet(info)[1] if reml else 0))
   return (ll,b,C) if full else -ll
  except (ValueError,np.linalg.LinAlgError,OverflowError):return 1e30
 bounds=None if code==1 else [(-12,12)]*ns+[(-.98,.98)]*(len(th)-ns)
 s=optimize.minimize(objective,th,method='SLSQP',bounds=bounds,options={'ftol':1e-10,'maxiter':1000})
 nm=optimize.minimize(objective,s.x,method='Nelder-Mead',options={'xatol':1e-8,'fatol':1e-10,'maxiter':3000})
 best=min([s,nm],key=lambda r:r.fun)
 return objective(best.x,True)
for k in range(54):
 code=k%9;reml=(k//9)%2;m=4;t=np.arange(m,dtype=float);p=parameters(code,m);C=cov(code,t,p);rows=[]
 for group in range(16):
  ix=np.arange(m) if group%3 else np.array([0,2,3])
  y=.7+.3*t[ix]+.5*(group%2)+rng.multivariate_normal(np.zeros(len(ix)),C[np.ix_(ix,ix)])
  rows.extend(np.c_[np.repeat(group%2,len(ix)),t[ix],y,np.repeat(group,len(ix)),t[ix]])
 rows=np.array(rows);r=run('repeated_model',rows,[code,reml,600,1e-9]);ll,b,CC=repeated_oracle(rows,code,np.array(p),reml)
 close(r['log_likelihood'],ll,'repeated_ll',1e-7,1e-7);close(r['coefficients'],b,'repeated_beta',3e-4,3e-5);close(r['covariance_by_level'],CC,'repeated_cov',3e-4,3e-5)
 assert r['optimizer_converged'],('repeated optimizer',code,reml,r['gradient_norm'])
 diagnostics.append([code,reml,r['converged'],r['variance_boundary'],r['covariance_parameters_identified']])
 count('repeated_ML_REML')

def slope_oracle(data,reml):
 u,y,g=data.T;x=np.c_[np.ones(len(y)),u]
 def decode(th):
  L=np.array([[np.exp(th[0]),0],[th[1],np.exp(th[2])]]);G=L@L.T;V=np.eye(len(y))
  for gid in np.unique(g):
   ix=np.flatnonzero(g==gid);V[np.ix_(ix,ix)]+=x[ix]@G@x[ix].T
  return G,V
 def obj(th):
  try:
   G,V=decode(th);r=profile(y,x,V,reml);return -r['log_likelihood']
  except (ValueError,OverflowError,np.linalg.LinAlgError):return 1e100
 fits=[optimize.minimize(obj,s,method='BFGS',options={'gtol':1e-8,'maxiter':1000}) for s in [[1,0,1],[0,.2,0]]]
 fit=min(fits,key=lambda r:r.fun);G,V=decode(fit.x);r=profile(y,x,V,reml);G*=r['scale'];V*=r['scale'];vi=np.linalg.inv(V);e=y-x@r['beta'];conditional=x@r['beta']
 for gid in np.unique(g):
  ix=np.flatnonzero(g==gid);b=G@x[ix].T@vi[np.ix_(ix,ix)]@e[ix];conditional[ix]+=x[ix]@b
 return r,G,conditional
for k in range(32):
 rows=[];reml=k%2
 for g in range(16):
  nn=int(rng.integers(3,7));u=np.sort(rng.uniform(-2,2,nn));b=rng.multivariate_normal([0,0],[[1,.25],[.25,.6]])
  y=2.+.8*u+b[0]+b[1]*u+rng.normal(0,.25,nn);rows.extend(np.c_[u,y,np.repeat(g,nn)])
 data=np.array(rows);r=run('random_slope_model',data,[reml,600,1e-9]);ref,G,cond=slope_oracle(data,reml)
 close(r['coefficients'],ref['beta'],'slope_beta',2e-5,2e-6);close(r['log_likelihood'],ref['log_likelihood'],'slope_ll',1e-7,1e-7);close(r['residual_variance'],ref['scale'],'slope_scale',2e-5,2e-6);close(r['random_effect_covariance'],G,'slope_G',2e-5,2e-6);close(r['conditional_fitted_values'],cond,'BLUP',2e-5,2e-6)
 assert r['converged'],('slope convergence',k,r['gradient_norm'])

 pp=run('random_slope_predict',data[:,[0,2]],r['predict_parameters']);close(pp['predictions'],cond,'portable_predict',2e-5,2e-6);count('portable_BLUP_prediction')
 data[:,0]=data[:,0]*2.5+1e6;data[:,1]=data[:,1]*3.5+7
 shifted=run('random_slope_model',data,[reml,600,1e-9]);close(shifted['conditional_fitted_values'],cond*3.5+7,'units_predict',2e-5,2e-6)
 delta=-(len(data)-2 if reml else len(data))*np.log(3.5)-(np.log(2.5) if reml else 0)

from research import *
def fit_known_fixture(code,reml):
 r=repeated_fixture(code);rows=r['data'];t=np.unique(rows[:,-1]);m=len(t);y=rows[:,2];x=np.c_[np.ones(len(rows)),rows[:,:2]]
 groups=[np.flatnonzero(rows[:,3]==g) for g in np.unique(rows[:,3])]
 def decode(th):
  if code==1:
   L=np.zeros((m,m));L[np.tril_indices(m)]=th
   L[np.diag_indices(m)]=np.exp(L[np.diag_indices(m)])
   V=L@L.T;return V,V[np.tril_indices(m)]
  ns=m if code in (0,3,6,7) else 1
  p=np.r_[np.exp(th[:ns]),th[ns:]]
  return cov(code,t,p),p
 p=np.array(r['parameters']);ns=m if code in (0,3,6,7) else 1
 if code==1:
  L=np.linalg.cholesky(r['covariance']);L[np.diag_indices(m)]=np.log(L[np.diag_indices(m)]);th=L[np.tril_indices(m)]
 else:th=np.r_[np.log(p[:ns]),p[ns:]]
 def evaluate(th):
  C,_=decode(th)
  ev=np.linalg.eigvalsh(C)
  if min(ev)<=1e-10:return 1e30
  V=np.zeros((len(y),len(y)))
  for ix in groups:
   ti=rows[ix,-1].astype(int);V[np.ix_(ix,ix)]=C[np.ix_(ti,ti)]
  vi=np.linalg.inv(V);info=x.T@vi@x;b=np.linalg.solve(info,x.T@vi@y);e=y-x@b
  ll=-.5*((len(y)-x.shape[1] if reml else len(y))*np.log(2*np.pi)+np.linalg.slogdet(V)[1]+e@vi@e+(np.linalg.slogdet(info)[1] if reml else 0))
  return -ll
 # Unlike production profile-shape parameterization: optimize all physical scale
 # parameters, using SLSQP and explicit positive eigenvalue constraint.
 bounds=None if code==1 else [(-12,12)]*ns+[(-.98,.98)]*(len(th)-ns)
 fits=[optimize.minimize(evaluate,th,method='SLSQP',bounds=bounds,options={'ftol':1e-11,'maxiter':1000}),
       optimize.minimize(evaluate,th,method='Nelder-Mead',options={'xatol':1e-9,'fatol':1e-10,'maxiter':4000})]
 fit=min(fits,key=lambda z:z.fun);C,p=decode(fit.x)
 return dict(parameters=p,covariance=C,log_likelihood=-fit.fun,success=bool(fit.success),message=fit.message)
if __name__=='__main__':
 out={}
 for c in range(9):
  for reml in (False,True):
   k=f'{c}_{int(reml)}';out[k]=fit_known_fixture(c,reml);print(k,out[k]['success'],out[k]['log_likelihood'])
 json.dump(out,open('/private/tmp/rusta-ducksmiles-jmp-target/mixed-advanced-check/repeated-fit-fixtures.json','w'),default=serial,indent=2)
